en.title: Safe motor start-stop
en.summary: Walk through a motor with seal-in, stop, and overload handling using the Motor Start Stop example.
en.scope: Tests provide native POSIX host evidence only; they are not hardware or HIL evidence.
objectives: Hold the motor on after Start is released with a seal-in.
Drop the motor out on Stop, EStop and Overload, and never let a held Start restart it by itself.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Motor.st, replace Forward := Start with a seal-in built from Start, Stop, EStop, and Overload; verify that Reverse remains FALSE.
stages.checkpoint: Forward stays ON after Start is released and drops on Stop, EStop, or Overload.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict Motor.Forward at 0, 20, 40, 50, 90, and 140 ms.
stages.checkpoint: OFF at 0 ms even though Start is held; ON at 20; OFF at 40 (EStop) and still OFF at 50 while Start is held; OFF at 90 (Overload) and 140 (Stop). It turns ON again only after Start is released and pressed again, at 70, 120, and 170 ms. Motor.Reverse remains OFF.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter loses seal-in when Start is released; implement Stop, EStop, and Overload dropout, and never start or restart while Start is still held after power-up or a stop.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the MotorStartStop scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named MotorStartStop and contains 27 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare the trace: EStop at 40 ms, overload at 90 ms, and stop at 140 ms.
stages.checkpoint: EStop, Overload, and Stop force Motor.Forward OFF, and holding Start does not restart it.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The exact NEVER assertion checks logical coverage for this scenario.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish physical safety, hardware timing, or certification.

hints.text: The output has to remember that Start was pressed: keep a memory variable that Start sets and that holds itself until a stop condition clears it.
Clear the memory first when Stop, EStop or Overload is TRUE; only then let Start set it, and only if Start was seen released since the last stop, so a held Start cannot restart the motor.

faultCases: The starter loses seal-in when Start is released; implement Stop, EStop, and Overload dropout, and never start or restart while Start is still held after power-up or a stop.

es.title: Arranque y parada seguros
es.summary: Recorra un motor con enclavamiento, parada y sobrecarga usando el ejemplo Motor Start Stop.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es del host nativo POSIX; no es evidencia de hardware ni HIL.
objectives: Mantenga el motor encendido tras soltar Start con un seal-in.
Baje el motor con Stop, EStop y Overload, y evite que un Start mantenido lo rearranque solo.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/Motor.st, reemplace Forward := Start por un seal-in armado con Start, Stop, EStop y Overload; verifique que Reverse permanece FALSE.
stages.checkpoint: Forward sigue ON al soltar Start y cae con Stop, EStop o Overload.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe Motor.Forward a 0, 20, 40, 50, 90 y 140 ms.
stages.checkpoint: OFF a 0 ms aunque Start esté pulsado; ON a 20; OFF a 40 (EStop) y todavía OFF a 50 con Start pulsado; OFF a 90 (sobrecarga) y 140 (Stop). Vuelve a ON sólo tras soltar y volver a pulsar Start, a 70, 120 y 170 ms. Motor.Reverse permanece OFF.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter pierde el enclavamiento al soltar Start; implemente baja por Stop, EStop y sobrecarga, sin arrancar ni rearrancar mientras Start siga pulsado tras el encendido o una parada.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario MotorStartStop.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama MotorStartStop y contiene 27 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare la traza: EStop a 40 ms, sobrecarga a 90 ms y parada a 140 ms.
stages.checkpoint: EStop, Overload y Stop fuerzan Motor.Forward OFF, y mantener Start no lo reinicia.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: La assertion exacta NEVER comprueba cobertura lógica de este escenario.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestra seguridad física, temporización de hardware ni certificación.

hints.text: La salida tiene que recordar que se pulsó Start: use una variable de memoria que Start active y que se mantenga hasta que una condición de parada la borre.

Borre la memoria primero cuando Stop, EStop u Overload sea TRUE; recién después deje que Start la active, y sólo si Start se vio suelto desde la última parada, así un Start mantenido no rearranca el motor.

faultCases: El starter pierde el enclavamiento al soltar Start; implemente baja por Stop, EStop y sobrecarga, sin arrancar ni rearrancar mientras Start siga pulsado tras el encendido o una parada.

en.title: Pedestrian crossing and safe states
en.summary: Walk through pedestrian-crossing states with mutually consistent vehicle and pedestrian outputs.
en.scope: Tests provide deterministic native POSIX host evidence only; they are not physical crossing, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Model the crossing as numbered states, each with an explicit output combination.
Show WALK only while the vehicles are red.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/PedestrianCrossing.st, add the states that coordinate vehicles and pedestrians; the plant raises PedRequest from 10 ms.
stages.checkpoint: Each state must leave an explicit output combination.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict the light and pedestrian-signal sequence.
stages.checkpoint: green+STOP 0 ms; yellow+STOP 20; red+STOP 40; red+WALK 60; red+STOP 90; green+STOP 110.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter ignores the pedestrian request; after PedRequest run yellow, red clearance, WALK, and red recovery before returning to green, and show WALK only while the vehicles are red.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the PedestrianCrossing scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named PedestrianCrossing and contains 15 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Review the recorded matrix in Tests and compare every sample with the prediction.
stages.checkpoint: The trace shows WALK only during the red state.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The NEVER assertion covers logically incompatible outputs only in this scenario.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish a physical crossing, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Keep one State variable and one counter of scans; at the top of every scan set all outputs to the safe default (vehicles stopped, pedestrians told to wait) and let each state turn on only what it needs.
The sequence is green, yellow, red clearance, WALK, red recovery, then green again; leave green only on PedRequest and move to the next state when the scan counter reaches that phase's length.

faultCases: The starter ignores the pedestrian request; after PedRequest run yellow, red clearance, WALK, and red recovery before returning to green, and show WALK only while the vehicles are red.

es.title: Cruce peatonal y estados seguros
es.summary: Recorra estados de cruce peatonal con salidas de vehículo y peatón mutuamente consistentes.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es determinística del host nativo POSIX; no es evidencia de cruce físico, hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Modele el cruce como estados numerados, cada uno con una combinación de salidas explícita.
Muestre WALK sólo mientras los vehículos están en rojo.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/PedestrianCrossing.st, agregue los estados que coordinan vehículos y peatones; la planta levanta PedRequest desde 10 ms.
stages.checkpoint: Cada estado debe dejar una combinación de salidas explícita.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe la secuencia de luces y señal peatonal.
stages.checkpoint: verde+STOP 0 ms; amarillo+STOP 20; rojo+STOP 40; rojo+WALK 60; rojo+STOP 90; verde+STOP 110.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter ignora el pedido peatonal; tras PedRequest ejecute amarillo, despeje en rojo, WALK y rojo de recuperación antes de volver a verde, y muestre WALK sólo con los vehículos en rojo.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario PedestrianCrossing.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama PedestrianCrossing y contiene 15 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Revise la matriz registrada en Tests y compare cada muestra con la predicción.
stages.checkpoint: La traza muestra el cambio a WALK sólo durante el estado rojo.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: La assertion NEVER cubre salidas incompatibles lógicas sólo en este escenario.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestra un cruce físico, temporización de hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: Mantenga una variable State y un contador de scans; al comienzo de cada scan ponga todas las salidas en el valor seguro (vehículos detenidos, peatones en espera) y deje que cada estado encienda sólo lo que necesita.

La secuencia es verde, amarillo, despeje en rojo, WALK, rojo de recuperación y de nuevo verde; salga de verde sólo con PedRequest y pase al estado siguiente cuando el contador de scans alcance la duración de esa fase.

faultCases: El starter ignora el pedido peatonal; tras PedRequest ejecute amarillo, despeje en rojo, WALK y rojo de recuperación antes de volver a verde, y muestre WALK sólo con los vehículos en rojo.

en.title: Tank level, faults, and reset
en.summary: Walk through level control and the fault and reset latches in the Tank Level example.
en.scope: Tests provide deterministic native POSIX host evidence only; they are not physical-process, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Keep the pump on from LevelLow until LevelHigh with a latch.
Latch the alarm on PumpFault or EStop and release it only with a fresh Reset after the fault has cleared.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/TankLevel.st, add PumpLatched, FaultLatched, and ResetArmed memories (or equivalents); the plant owns LevelLow and LevelHigh.
stages.checkpoint: Pump, fault, and reset memory must have explicit states.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict the pump and alarm through the level and fault changes.
stages.checkpoint: Pump ON/Alarm NORMAL 10–60 ms; Pump OFF/Alarm NORMAL 70 ms; OFF/ALARM 80–90; OFF/NORMAL 100–110; OFF/ALARM 120–130; OFF/NORMAL 140–150.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter has no pump hysteresis and runs through a pump fault; keep the pump on from LevelLow until LevelHigh, latch the alarm on PumpFault or EStop, and release it only with a Reset pressed after the fault has cleared.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the TankLevel scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named TankLevel and contains 13 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Relate 80/100/120/140 ms to fault, reset, EStop, and recovery; Pump+Alarm must never coexist.
stages.checkpoint: The recorded matrix in Tests shows every pump and alarm transition.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The NEVER assertion covers Pump+Alarm only in this recorded scenario.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish a physical process, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: LevelLow goes FALSE as soon as the level rises, so the pump needs its own memory (PumpLatched) that LevelLow sets and LevelHigh clears.

Add FaultLatched, set by PumpFault or EStop and kept after the input goes away, and ResetArmed, set only when Reset is seen released while the fault is latched; clear FaultLatched on a Reset press while armed and with no fault input present, and gate Pump with NOT FaultLatched.

faultCases: The starter has no pump hysteresis and runs through a pump fault; keep the pump on from LevelLow until LevelHigh, latch the alarm on PumpFault or EStop, and release it only with a Reset pressed after the fault has cleared.

es.title: Nivel de tanque, fallas y reset
es.summary: Recorra el control de nivel y los enclavamientos de falla y reset del ejemplo Tank Level.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es determinística del host nativo POSIX; no es evidencia de proceso físico, hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Mantenga la bomba encendida desde LevelLow hasta LevelHigh con un enclavamiento.
Enclave la alarma con PumpFault o EStop y libérela sólo con un Reset nuevo tras despejarse la falla.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/TankLevel.st, agregue las memorias PumpLatched, FaultLatched y ResetArmed (o equivalentes); la planta es dueña de LevelLow y LevelHigh.
stages.checkpoint: Las memorias de bomba, falla y reset deben tener estados explícitos.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe la bomba y alarma durante los cambios de nivel y falla.
stages.checkpoint: Pump ON/Alarm NORMAL 10–60 ms; Pump OFF/Alarm NORMAL 70 ms; OFF/ALARM 80–90; OFF/NORMAL 100–110; OFF/ALARM 120–130; OFF/NORMAL 140–150.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter no tiene histéresis de bomba y sigue funcionando ante una falla de bomba; mantenga la bomba desde LevelLow hasta LevelHigh, enclave la alarma con PumpFault o EStop y libérela sólo con un Reset pulsado tras despejarse la falla.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario TankLevel.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama TankLevel y contiene 13 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Relacione 80/100/120/140 ms con fault, reset, EStop y la recuperación; nunca deben coexistir Pump+Alarm.
stages.checkpoint: La matriz registrada en Tests muestra cada transición de bomba y alarma.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: La assertion NEVER cubre Pump+Alarm sólo en este escenario registrado.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestra un proceso físico, temporización de hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: LevelLow cae a FALSE apenas sube el nivel, así que la bomba necesita su propia memoria (PumpLatched) que LevelLow active y LevelHigh borre.

Agregue FaultLatched, activada por PumpFault o EStop y conservada cuando la entrada desaparece, y ResetArmed, activada sólo cuando Reset se ve suelto con la falla enclavada; borre FaultLatched con un Reset pulsado estando armado y sin entradas de falla, y condicione Pump con NOT FaultLatched.

faultCases: El starter no tiene histéresis de bomba y sigue funcionando ante una falla de bomba; mantenga la bomba desde LevelLow hasta LevelHigh, enclave la alarma con PumpFault o EStop y libérela sólo con un Reset pulsado tras despejarse la falla.

en.title: Conveyor classification and safe jam
en.summary: Walk through part classification and the safe jam lockout in the Conveyor 01 example.
en.scope: Tests provide deterministic native POSIX host evidence only; they are not physical conveyor, jam clearance, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Stop the belt and light FaultLamp while the plant reports JamDetected.
Keep Reset from releasing the fault while the jam is still present.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Conveyor.st, keep Requested and MetalLatched and add Faulted; the sensors belong to the plant.
stages.checkpoint: The logic commands outputs only from plant-recorded sensors.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict the belt, diverter, and fault lamp.
stages.checkpoint: Belt ON 10–40; Diverter ON only 30; FaultLamp ON and Belt OFF 50–80. Reset at 60 does not release while JamDetected remains active.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter misses the deterministic jam lockout; stop the belt and light FaultLamp while the plant reports JamDetected, and do not let Reset release it while the jam remains.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only Conveyor01; the starter also ships ConveyorJamTiming (lesson 9), so Tests-all would grade two scenarios.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named Conveyor01 and contains 6 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Review the matrix: classifier+metal 20, diverter+count=1 at 30, jam 50.
stages.checkpoint: The jam turns FaultLamp on and stops Belt.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The NEVER assertion covers DiverterCommand ON with BeltCommand OFF only in this scenario.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish a physical conveyor, jam clearance, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: A jam must win over everything else: when JamDetected is TRUE, latch a Faulted memory and drop the belt request, so the belt stays stopped even after the jam input goes away.
Compute BeltCommand as Requested AND NOT Faulted, FaultLamp as Faulted OR JamDetected, and clear Faulted with Reset only when JamDetected is FALSE.

faultCases: The starter misses the deterministic jam lockout; stop the belt and light FaultLamp while the plant reports JamDetected, and do not let Reset release it while the jam remains.

es.title: Cinta de clasificación y atasco seguro
es.summary: Recorra la clasificación de piezas y el bloqueo seguro por atasco del ejemplo Conveyor 01.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es determinística del host nativo POSIX; no es evidencia de cinta física, despeje de atasco, hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Detenga la cinta y encienda FaultLamp mientras la planta informa JamDetected.
Evite que Reset libere la falla mientras el atasco siga presente.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/Conveyor.st, conserve Requested y MetalLatched y agregue Faulted; los sensores pertenecen a la plant.
stages.checkpoint: La lógica sólo manda salidas a partir de sensores registrados por la plant.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe la cinta, desviador y lámpara de falla.
stages.checkpoint: Belt ON 10–40; Diverter ON sólo 30; FaultLamp ON y Belt OFF 50–80. Reset a 60 no libera mientras JamDetected sigue activo.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter no bloquea la cinta ante el atasco determinista; deténgala y encienda FaultLamp mientras la planta informa JamDetected, y evite que Reset la libere mientras el atasco siga.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente Conveyor01; el starter también incluye ConveyorJamTiming (lección 9), así que Tests-all calificaría dos escenarios.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama Conveyor01 y contiene 6 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Revise la matriz: classifier+metal 20, diverter+count=1 a 30, jam 50.
stages.checkpoint: El atasco enciende FaultLamp y detiene Belt.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: La assertion NEVER cubre DiverterCommand ON con BeltCommand OFF sólo en este escenario.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestra cinta física, despeje de atasco, temporización de hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: Un atasco tiene que ganar sobre todo lo demás: con JamDetected en TRUE, enclave una memoria Faulted y suelte el pedido de cinta, así la cinta queda detenida aunque la entrada de atasco desaparezca.
Calcule BeltCommand como Requested AND NOT Faulted, FaultLamp como Faulted OR JamDetected, y borre Faulted con Reset sólo cuando JamDetected sea FALSE.

faultCases: El starter no bloquea la cinta ante el atasco determinista; deténgala y encienda FaultLamp mientras la planta informa JamDetected, y evite que Reset la libere mientras el atasco siga.

en.title: TON oscillator and output feedback
en.summary: Complete a 500 ms Ladder blinker made of two TON timers and SET and RESET coils, and check its on and off times with FOR and AT assertions.
en.scope: Tests provide native POSIX host evidence only; they are not physical LED, hardware timing, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Read a two-timer Ladder oscillator: each timer runs in one half period and starts the next.
Complete it with a SET coil and a RESET coil driven by the timers' Q outputs.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/Blinky.ld.json the two timer rungs are already drawn: OffTimer runs while LED_Output is OFF and OnTimer runs while it is ON. Add the two coil rungs: a contact on OffTimer.Q that SETs LED_Output, and a contact on OnTimer.Q that RESETs it.
stages.checkpoint: The timers' outputs feed back to set and reset the LED, and the LED starts OFF.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict LED_Output at 250, 750, 1250, and 1750 ms.
stages.checkpoint: OFF at 250 ms, ON at 750, OFF at 1250, ON at 1750; the first rising edge lands between 400 and 600 ms.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter has the two timers but no coils, so LED_Output stays OFF forever; add a SET coil driven by OffTimer.Q and a RESET coil driven by OnTimer.Q, so the LED is OFF for about 500 ms, then ON for about 500 ms, and repeats.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the BlinkyVisual scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named BlinkyVisual and contains 11 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Review the trace and table: OFF until about 500 ms, ON until about 1000 ms, OFF again, then ON from about 1500 ms.
stages.checkpoint: The three FOR windows (20-400 ms OFF, 620-900 ms ON, 1120-1400 ms OFF) hold, and both rising edges and the falling edge are found.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: A program that toggles on every scan, blinks twice as fast, or stays ON only 20% of the time fails the FOR and AT assertions.
stages.checkpoint: The host scenario grades the logical waveform, not the technique (a 500 ms or 510 ms half period passes); it does not establish electrical period, brightness, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Look at the first two rungs: OffTimer only runs while LED_Output is OFF and OnTimer only while it is ON, so something has to flip LED_Output when each one finishes.
Add a rung with a normally open contact on OffTimer.Q and a SET coil on LED_Output, and another with a contact on OnTimer.Q and a RESET coil on LED_Output.

faultCases: The starter has the two timers but no coils, so LED_Output stays OFF forever; add a SET coil driven by OffTimer.Q and a RESET coil driven by OnTimer.Q, so the LED is OFF for about 500 ms, then ON for about 500 ms, and repeats.

es.title: Oscilador TON y realimentación de salida
es.summary: Complete un parpadeo Ladder de 500 ms hecho con dos temporizadores TON y bobinas SET y RESET, y verifique sus tiempos de encendido y apagado con assertions FOR y AT.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es del host nativo POSIX; no es evidencia de LED físico, timing de hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Lea un oscilador Ladder de dos temporizadores: cada uno corre en un semiperíodo y arranca al siguiente.
Completalo con una bobina SET y una bobina RESET manejadas por las salidas Q de los temporizadores.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/Blinky.ld.json ya están dibujados los dos peldaños de temporizador: OffTimer corre mientras LED_Output está OFF y OnTimer corre mientras está ON. Agregue los dos peldaños de bobina: un contacto sobre OffTimer.Q que haga SET de LED_Output y un contacto sobre OnTimer.Q que le haga RESET.
stages.checkpoint: Las salidas de los temporizadores se realimentan para activar y desactivar el LED, y el LED arranca en OFF.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe LED_Output a 250, 750, 1250 y 1750 ms.
stages.checkpoint: OFF a 250 ms, ON a 750, OFF a 1250, ON a 1750; el primer flanco ascendente cae entre 400 y 600 ms.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter tiene los dos temporizadores pero ninguna bobina, así que LED_Output queda en OFF para siempre; agregue una bobina SET manejada por OffTimer.Q y una bobina RESET manejada por OnTimer.Q, de modo que el LED esté OFF unos 500 ms, luego ON unos 500 ms, y repita.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario BlinkyVisual.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama BlinkyVisual y contiene 11 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Revise la traza y la tabla: OFF hasta unos 500 ms, ON hasta unos 1000 ms, OFF de nuevo y ON otra vez desde unos 1500 ms.
stages.checkpoint: Las tres ventanas FOR (20-400 ms OFF, 620-900 ms ON, 1120-1400 ms OFF) se sostienen, y se encuentran los dos flancos ascendentes y el descendente.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: Un programa que invierte la salida en cada scan, parpadea al doble de velocidad o queda ON sólo el 20 % del tiempo falla las assertions FOR y AT.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario host evalúa la forma de onda lógica, no la técnica (un semiperíodo de 500 o 510 ms pasa); no demuestra período eléctrico, brillo, timing de hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: Mire los dos primeros peldaños: OffTimer sólo corre mientras LED_Output está OFF y OnTimer sólo mientras está ON, así que algo tiene que invertir LED_Output cuando cada uno termina.
Agregue un peldaño con un contacto normalmente abierto sobre OffTimer.Q y una bobina SET sobre LED_Output, y otro con un contacto sobre OnTimer.Q y una bobina RESET sobre LED_Output.

faultCases: El starter tiene los dos temporizadores pero ninguna bobina, así que LED_Output queda en OFF para siempre; agregue una bobina SET manejada por OffTimer.Q y una bobina RESET manejada por OnTimer.Q, de modo que el LED esté OFF unos 500 ms, luego ON unos 500 ms, y repita.

en.title: Command, feedback, and speed
en.summary: Separate a motor command from the run confirmation using the Motor Plant.
en.scope: Tests provide deterministic native POSIX host and discrete-plant evidence only; they are not physical-motor, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Separate the command to the motor from the confirmation that it runs.
Keep the request until Stop and let Running follow the request only once AtSpeed arrives.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/MotorPlant.st, keep a Requested memory set by Start and cleared by Stop, and wire Requested, Command, and Running.
stages.checkpoint: Command reflects the request; Running also depends on AtSpeed.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, distinguish the command from the confirmation.
stages.checkpoint: 0 ms: Command/Running OFF; 10: Command ON and Running OFF; 30: both ON; 40: both OFF.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter loses Command when Start falls and ignores Stop; retain the request until Stop and gate Running with AtSpeed.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the MotorPlant scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named MotorPlant and contains 7 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare 10 with 30 ms: the plant records the command before AtSpeed; Stop at 40 turns both off.
stages.checkpoint: The recorded matrix and trace show the discrete speed/AtSpeed advance.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: RISING/FALLING cover this transition, and NEVER checks that Running never appears without Command in this scenario.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish inertia, a physical motor, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Start only needs a pulse, so the request has to be remembered: set Requested with Start and clear it with Stop (Stop wins when both are TRUE).
Drive Command from Requested and Running from Requested AND AtSpeed: Command rises first, Running follows when the plant reports speed, and both fall together at Stop.

faultCases: The starter loses Command when Start falls and ignores Stop; retain the request until Stop and gate Running with AtSpeed.

es.title: Comando, realimentación y velocidad
es.summary: Separe la orden del motor de la confirmación de marcha usando la planta Motor Plant.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es determinística del host nativo POSIX y de la planta discreta; no es evidencia de motor físico, hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Separe la orden al motor de la confirmación de que está en marcha.
Retenga el pedido hasta Stop y deje que Running siga al pedido sólo cuando llegue AtSpeed.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/MotorPlant.st, mantenga una memoria Requested que Start activa y Stop borra, y cablee Requested, Command y Running.
stages.checkpoint: Command expresa la orden; Running depende además de AtSpeed.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, diferencie la orden de la confirmación.
stages.checkpoint: 0 ms: Command/Running OFF; 10: Command ON y Running OFF; 30: ambos ON; 40: ambos OFF.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter pierde Command cuando cae Start y no respeta Stop; retenga el pedido hasta Stop y condicione Running con AtSpeed.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario MotorPlant.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama MotorPlant y contiene 7 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare 10 con 30 ms: la planta registra orden antes de AtSpeed; Stop a 40 apaga ambos.
stages.checkpoint: La matriz y la traza registradas muestran el avance discreto de speed/AtSpeed.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: RISING/FALLING cubren esta transición y NEVER comprueba que Running no aparezca sin Command dentro de este escenario.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestra inercia, motor físico, timing de hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: Start sólo necesita un pulso, así que el pedido tiene que recordarse: active Requested con Start y borralo con Stop (Stop gana si ambos están en TRUE).
Maneje Command desde Requested y Running desde Requested AND AtSpeed: Command sube primero, Running lo sigue cuando la planta informa velocidad, y ambos caen juntos con Stop.

faultCases: El starter pierde Command cuando cae Start y no respeta Stop; retenga el pedido hasta Stop y condicione Running con AtSpeed.

en.title: Edges and pulse counter
en.summary: Use a CTU counter to count three discrete pulses and reset the count.
en.scope: Tests provide native POSIX host evidence only; they are not physical-sensor, bounce, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Count three rising edges of PulseInput with a CTU counter.
Reset the count and CountReached with Reset.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/EdgeCounter.st, use PulseInput, Reset, and CountReached and add a Count (CTU) instance with PV=3.
stages.checkpoint: CTU counts each rising edge of PulseInput once, however long the pulse stays high; Reset clears the count.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict when the counter reaches PV=3.
stages.checkpoint: CountReached stays OFF at 0, 10, and 30 ms; turns ON at 50 after the third edge; returns OFF at 70 with Reset.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter never counts; add a CTU with PV=3 so CountReached turns ON on the third rising edge and Reset turns it OFF.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the EdgeCounter scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named EdgeCounter and contains 7 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare 10, 30, 50, and 70 ms with CountReached.
stages.checkpoint: The third pulse reaches PV=3; Reset dominates and returns CountReached to OFF.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: The AT/RISING/FALLING assertions cover this discrete logical sequence.
stages.checkpoint: They do not establish bounce, electrical pulses, hardware timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: A CTU already counts only rising edges of CU, so a long pulse still counts once; you do not need to detect the edge yourself.
Declare Count : CTU, call it every scan as Count(CU := PulseInput, R := Reset, PV := 3) and copy Count.Q to CountReached.

faultCases: The starter never counts; add a CTU with PV=3 so CountReached turns ON on the third rising edge and Reset turns it OFF.

es.title: Flancos y contador de pulsos
es.summary: Use un contador CTU para contar tres pulsos discretos y resetear la cuenta.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es del host nativo POSIX; no es evidencia de sensor físico, rebote, hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Cuente tres flancos ascendentes de PulseInput con un contador CTU.
Resetee la cuenta y CountReached con Reset.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/EdgeCounter.st, use PulseInput, Reset y CountReached y agregue una instancia Count (CTU) con PV=3.
stages.checkpoint: CTU cuenta una vez cada flanco ascendente de PulseInput, sin importar cuánto tiempo siga en alto el pulso; Reset borra la cuenta.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe cuándo el contador alcanza PV=3.
stages.checkpoint: CountReached permanece OFF a 0, 10 y 30 ms; enciende a 50 tras el tercer flanco; vuelve OFF a 70 con Reset.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter nunca cuenta; agregue un CTU con PV=3 para que CountReached encienda en el tercer flanco ascendente y Reset lo apague.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario EdgeCounter.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama EdgeCounter y contiene 7 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare los eventos de 10, 30, 50 y 70 ms con la salida CountReached.
stages.checkpoint: El tercer pulso alcanza PV=3; Reset domina y devuelve CountReached a OFF.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: Las assertions AT/RISING/FALLING cubren esta secuencia lógica discreta.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestran rebote, pulsos eléctricos, timing de hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: Un CTU ya cuenta sólo flancos ascendentes de CU, así que un pulso largo cuenta una sola vez; no necesita detectar el flanco usted mismo.
Declare Count : CTU, llamalo en cada scan como Count(CU := PulseInput, R := Reset, PV := 3) y copie Count.Q a CountReached.

faultCases: El starter nunca cuenta; agregue un CTU con PV=3 para que CountReached encienda en el tercer flanco ascendente y Reset lo apague.

en.title: Scan cycle and one-scan memory
en.summary: Follow how one input produces the current output and a copy delayed by one scan.
en.scope: Tests provide native POSIX host runtime evidence with one 10 ms task; they do not establish target timing, snapshots under physical interrupts, electrical bounce, HIL, or certification.
objectives: See that a variable keeps its value from one scan to the next.
Build a one-scan delay and a one-scan pulse from a single memory.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: In src/ScanSnapshot.st, use Button, Current, Delayed, and RisingPulse and add the Previous memory.
stages.checkpoint: Previous updates at the end of the scan.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict the four recorded samples as Current, Delayed, RisingPulse.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter has no one-scan memory; keep Previous, set Delayed from it, derive RisingPulse from Current and Delayed, and update Previous last.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only the ScanSnapshot scenario.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named ScanSnapshot and contains 9 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare 10, 20, and 30 ms: RisingPulse lasts one scan and Delayed keeps the delayed copy.
stages.checkpoint: The pulse appears at 10 ms; Delayed appears at 20 ms and returns OFF at 30 ms.

stages.title: Evidence
stages.body: AT/RISING/FALLING/NEVER cover the scenario; hashes and trace belong to the host.
stages.checkpoint: Recorded evidence belongs to the executed host scenario.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: Updating Previous first would break the edge detector.
stages.checkpoint: Memory must retain the prior value until the end of the scan.

hints.text: Delayed has to be the Button of the previous scan, so it needs a variable that still holds the old value when the scan starts: Previous.
Write the statements in this order: Current := Button; Delayed := Previous; RisingPulse := Current AND NOT Delayed; and only then Previous := Button.

faultCases: The starter has no one-scan memory; keep Previous, set Delayed from it, derive RisingPulse from Current and Delayed, and update Previous last.

es.title: Ciclo de scan y memoria de un ciclo
es.summary: Siga cómo una entrada produce una salida actual y una copia demorada un scan.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es del runtime nativo POSIX host con una única tarea de 10 ms; no demuestra timing de target, snapshot bajo interrupciones físicas, rebote eléctrico, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Compruebe que una variable conserva su valor de un scan al siguiente.
Arme un retardo de un scan y un pulso de un scan con una única memoria.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: En src/ScanSnapshot.st, use Button, Current, Delayed y RisingPulse y agregue la memoria Previous.
stages.checkpoint: Previous se actualiza al final del scan.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe los cuatro samples registrados como Current, Delayed, RisingPulse.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter no tiene memoria de un scan; conserve Previous, calcule Delayed con él, derive RisingPulse de Current y Delayed y actualice Previous al final.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente el escenario ScanSnapshot.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama ScanSnapshot y contiene 9 assertions.

stages.title: Observe
stages.body: Compare 10, 20 y 30 ms: RisingPulse dura un scan y Delayed conserva la copia demorada.
stages.checkpoint: El pulso aparece a 10 ms; Delayed aparece a 20 ms y vuelve OFF a 30 ms.

stages.title: Evidencia
stages.body: AT/RISING/FALLING/NEVER cubren el escenario; los hashes y la traza pertenecen al host.
stages.checkpoint: La evidencia registrada es del escenario host ejecutado.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: Actualizar Previous antes rompería el detector de flanco.
stages.checkpoint: La memoria debe conservar el valor anterior hasta el final del scan.

hints.text: Delayed tiene que ser el Button del scan anterior, así que necesita una variable que todavía guarde el valor viejo al empezar el scan: Previous.
Escriba las sentencias en este orden: Current := Button; Delayed := Previous; RisingPulse := Current AND NOT Delayed; y recién después Previous := Button.

faultCases: El starter no tiene memoria de un scan; conserve Previous, calcule Delayed con él, derive RisingPulse de Current y Delayed y actualice Previous al final.

en.title: Temporal assertions and jam fault
en.summary: Latch the jam fault and prove its timing with AT, WITHIN, FOR, UNTIL, RISING, and FALLING assertions.
en.scope: Tests provide native POSIX host runtime and discrete-input evidence only; the scheduled jam is not a physical fault, physical clearance, target timing, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Latch the jam fault and prove its timing with temporal assertions.
Require a new Start before the belt moves again after the fault is released.

stages.title: Objective
stages.body: Read tests/conveyor-jam-timing.scenario.json next to src/Conveyor.st. Start is pressed at 0 ms, a jam appears at 30 ms and clears at 50 ms, Reset is pressed at 40 ms (jam present) and at 60 ms (jam cleared), and Start is pressed again at 80 ms.
stages.checkpoint: The starter must latch the jam fault (building on lesson 4) before the scenario can pass.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: Before running, predict BeltCommand and FaultLamp at 20, 30, 50, 60, and 80 ms.
stages.checkpoint: Belt ON and FaultLamp OFF at 20; Belt OFF and FaultLamp ON at 30 and still at 50 (Reset at 40 is ignored and the jam clearing does not release the fault); both OFF at 60; Belt ON again at 80 only after the new Start.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter misses the jam latch; latch the fault on JamDetected, ignore Reset while the jam is present, release it only with Reset after the jam clears, and require a new Start to run the belt again.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only ConveyorJamTiming; Conveyor01 is the lesson 4 scenario and stays a regression check.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named ConveyorJamTiming and contains 9 assertions.

stages.title: Compare
stages.body: Match each assertion to the trace: AT at 20, 50, and 60 ms pins the exact states; WITHIN at 30 ms proves the fault appears in the same scan as the jam; FOR from 30 to 50 ms holds across the early Reset; FALLING at 60 ms shows Reset released the lamp; UNTIL keeps the belt OFF until the new Start; RISING at 80 ms finds the restart.
stages.checkpoint: The recorded trace shows the discrete sequence, not a physical measurement.

stages.title: Reflect
stages.body: NEVER forbids BeltCommand and FaultLamp ON together in this scenario. A Reset while the jam is present must not release the fault, and releasing it must not restart the belt.
stages.checkpoint: An injected jam does not establish a physical fault, physical clearance, target timing, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: Build on lesson 4: JamDetected latches Faulted, and a Reset only counts when the jam input is gone; read the scenario times to see which Reset must be ignored.
Clear Requested and StartArmed when the jam appears, release Faulted only with Reset while JamDetected is FALSE, and let Requested come back only from a Start pressed after Start was seen released.

faultCases: The starter misses the jam latch; latch the fault on JamDetected, ignore Reset while the jam is present, release it only with Reset after the jam clears, and require a new Start to run the belt again.

es.title: Assertions temporales y falla por atasco
es.summary: Enclave la falla por atasco y pruebe su temporización con assertions AT, WITHIN, FOR, UNTIL, RISING y FALLING.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es del runtime nativo POSIX host y de inputs discretos; el atasco programado no es una falla física, despeje físico, timing de target, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Enclave la falla por atasco y pruebe su temporización con assertions temporales.
Exija un Start nuevo antes de mover la cinta otra vez tras liberar la falla.

stages.title: Objetivo
stages.body: Lea tests/conveyor-jam-timing.scenario.json junto a src/Conveyor.st. Start se pulsa a 0 ms, un atasco aparece a 30 ms y se despeja a 50 ms, Reset se pulsa a 40 ms (atasco presente) y a 60 ms (atasco despejado), y Start se pulsa de nuevo a 80 ms.
stages.checkpoint: El starter debe enclavar la falla por atasco (a partir de la lección 4) antes de aprobar el escenario.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: Antes de ejecutar, anticipe BeltCommand y FaultLamp a 20, 30, 50, 60 y 80 ms.
stages.checkpoint: Belt ON y FaultLamp OFF a 20; Belt OFF y FaultLamp ON a 30 y todavía a 50 (Reset a 40 se ignora y despejar el atasco no libera la falla); ambos OFF a 60; Belt ON de nuevo a 80 sólo tras el nuevo Start.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter omite el enclavamiento del atasco; enclave la falla con JamDetected, ignore Reset mientras el atasco esté presente, libérela sólo con Reset tras despejarse el atasco y exija un nuevo Start para volver a mover la cinta.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente ConveyorJamTiming; Conveyor01 es el escenario de la lección 4 y queda como chequeo de regresión.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama ConveyorJamTiming y contiene 9 assertions.

stages.title: Contraste
stages.body: Relacione cada assertion con la traza: AT a 20, 50 y 60 ms fija los estados exactos; WITHIN a 30 ms prueba que la falla aparece en el mismo scan que el atasco; FOR de 30 a 50 ms se sostiene a través del Reset temprano; FALLING a 60 ms muestra que Reset liberó la lámpara; UNTIL mantiene la cinta OFF hasta el nuevo Start; RISING a 80 ms encuentra el rearranque.
stages.checkpoint: La traza registrada muestra la secuencia discreta, no una medición física.

stages.title: Reflexione
stages.body: NEVER prohíbe BeltCommand y FaultLamp ON a la vez en este escenario. Un Reset con el atasco presente no debe liberar la falla, y liberarla no debe rearrancar la cinta.
stages.checkpoint: Un atasco inyectado no demuestra falla física, despeje físico, timing de target, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: Parta de la lección 4: JamDetected enclava Faulted, y un Reset sólo cuenta cuando la entrada de atasco ya no está; lea los tiempos del escenario para ver qué Reset debe ignorarse.

Borre Requested y StartArmed cuando aparece el atasco, libere Faulted sólo con Reset estando JamDetected en FALSE, y deje que Requested vuelva sólo con un Start pulsado después de haber visto Start suelto.

faultCases: El starter omite el enclavamiento del atasco; enclave la falla con JamDetected, ignore Reset mientras el atasco esté presente, libérela sólo con Reset tras despejarse el atasco y exija un nuevo Start para volver a mover la cinta.

en.title: Reproducible diagnosis: two parts, one decision
en.summary: Use the versioned schedule to distinguish one metal part from one non-metal part without inventing observability.
en.scope: Tests provide native POSIX host runtime evidence with scenario-scheduled inputs; they are not physical sensors or parts, target timing, hardware, HIL, or certification evidence.
objectives: Distinguish a metal part from a non-metal part with one memory that lives between two sensors.
Read a scheduled input timeline and predict the outputs before running it.

stages.title: Locate
stages.body: Use PartAtClassifier, MetalDetected, and PartAtDiverter in src/Conveyor.st and add MetalLatched.
stages.checkpoint: MetalLatched sets with classifier+metal and clears when the part reaches the diverter.

stages.title: Predict
stages.body: The first part is metal and the second is non-metal.
stages.checkpoint: Expect diversion only for the first; Belt stays active for both.

stages.title: Read the schedule
stages.body: The JSON schedules classifier→diverter at 20→30 ms and 50→70 ms, with a 10 ms tick through 80 ms. Start is pressed only at 0 ms, so the program must hold the belt request.
stages.checkpoint: The three assertions are AT@30 Belt=true/Diverter=true, AT@70 Belt=true/Diverter=false, and NEVER Diverter=true with Belt=false.

stages.title: Edit
stages.body: Correct this starter omission, save it, then run: The starter never latches metal for the diverter; hold the belt request after Start, latch metal at the classifier, and clear it only when the part reaches the diverter.
stages.checkpoint: The visible scenario must pass with saved host evidence.

stages.title: Run
stages.body: In Tests, choose the saved zplc.json and run only ConveyorTwoParts.
stages.checkpoint: The required scenario is named ConveyorTwoParts and contains 3 assertions.

stages.title: Diagnose
stages.body: The Tests matrix proves host outputs: compare the 30 and 70 ms samples.
stages.checkpoint: It does not prove or record inputs, physical parts, or the internal MetalLatched state.

stages.title: Limits
stages.body: Repeat the same scenario for a reproducible decision about host outputs.
stages.checkpoint: It does not establish physical sensors or parts, target timing, hardware, HIL, or certification.

hints.text: The classifier and the diverter see the part at different instants, so remember what the classifier saw: MetalLatched sets with PartAtClassifier AND MetalDetected.
Clear MetalLatched once the part reaches the diverter, drive DiverterCommand from BeltCommand AND PartAtDiverter AND MetalLatched, and hold the belt request after the single Start press at 0 ms.

faultCases: The starter never latches metal for the diverter; hold the belt request after Start, latch metal at the classifier, and clear it only when the part reaches the diverter.

es.title: Diagnóstico reproducible: dos piezas, una decisión
es.summary: Use el calendario versionado para distinguir una pieza metálica de una no metálica sin inventar observabilidad.
es.scope: La evidencia de Tests es del runtime nativo POSIX host con inputs programados por escenario; no es evidencia de sensores ni piezas físicas, timing de target, hardware, HIL ni certificación.
objectives: Distinga una pieza metálica de una no metálica con una memoria que vive entre dos sensores.
Lea una línea de tiempo de entradas agendadas y anticipe las salidas antes de ejecutarla.

stages.title: Ubique
stages.body: Use PartAtClassifier, MetalDetected y PartAtDiverter en src/Conveyor.st y agregue MetalLatched.
stages.checkpoint: MetalLatched se activa con clasificador+metal y se limpia al llegar al desviador.

stages.title: Prediga
stages.body: La primera pieza es metálica y la segunda no metálica.
stages.checkpoint: Espere desvío sólo para la primera; Belt queda activo para ambas.

stages.title: Lea el calendario
stages.body: El JSON agenda clasificador→desviador 20→30 ms y 50→70 ms, con tick de 10 ms hasta 80 ms. Start se pulsa sólo a 0 ms, así que el programa debe retener el pedido de cinta.
stages.checkpoint: Las tres assertions son AT@30 Belt=true/Diverter=true, AT@70 Belt=true/Diverter=false y NEVER Diverter=true con Belt=false.

stages.title: Edite
stages.body: Corrija esta omisión del starter y guarde antes de ejecutar: El starter nunca enclava metal para el desviador; retenga el pedido de cinta tras Start, enclave metal en el clasificador y liberalo recién cuando la pieza llega al desviador.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario visible debe pasar con evidencia host guardada.

stages.title: Ejecute
stages.body: En Tests, elija el zplc.json guardado y ejecute únicamente ConveyorTwoParts.
stages.checkpoint: El escenario requerido se llama ConveyorTwoParts y contiene 3 assertions.

stages.title: Diagnostique
stages.body: La matriz de Tests prueba outputs host: compare las muestras de 30 y 70 ms.
stages.checkpoint: No prueba ni registra inputs, piezas físicas ni el estado interno MetalLatched.

stages.title: Límites
stages.body: Repita el mismo escenario para una decisión reproducible sobre outputs del host.
stages.checkpoint: No demuestra sensores o piezas físicas, timing de target, hardware, HIL ni certificación.

hints.text: El clasificador y el desviador ven la pieza en instantes distintos, así que recuerde lo que vio el clasificador: MetalLatched se activa con PartAtClassifier AND MetalDetected.

Borre MetalLatched cuando la pieza llega al desviador, maneje DiverterCommand desde BeltCommand AND PartAtDiverter AND MetalLatched, y retenga el pedido de cinta tras la única pulsación de Start a 0 ms.

faultCases: El starter nunca enclava metal para el desviador; retenga el pedido de cinta tras Start, enclave metal en el clasificador y liberalo recién cuando la pieza llega al desviador.
